summary: Iteration 4 re-verification of iter3 auto-assign + team accept flow. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases PASSED (/app/backend/tests/test_iter3_auto_assign.py) covering (a) GET/PATCH /api/settings RBAC — admin/super_admin 200, team/subscriber 403; (b) auto_assign=true → new complaint stamped status='assigned' + assigned_to (a team user) + auto_assigned=true, assigned tech sees ticket in GET /api/complaints; (c) auto_assign=false → complaint stays status='open'+assigned_to=null, team GET /api/complaints returns it, team PATCH assigned_to=self succeeds (status flips to 'assigned'), team PATCH assigned_to=admin_id → 403, team self-claim on ticket already owned by another tech → 403; (d) team PATCH status in_progress→resolved with resolution_note works; (e) subscriber sees only own complaints and cannot change status; (f) admin manual assign still works with auto_assigned=false stamp. auto_assign restored to true at end. Frontend smoke (390x844): subscriber (9999999996) logs in, new-complaint-fab opens the modal with title/description/priority + Submit; team screen showed filter-new/filter-active/filter-resolved segments and ticket cards. Full team-side accept/in_progress/resolve UI flow was already fully covered and verified in iteration_3 (see iteration_3.json).

issues: Carry-over RN Web deprecation warnings (shadow* → boxShadow; props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: (a) migrate deprecated RN Web shadow*/pointerEvents style props; (b) add explicit testIDs on the subscriber new-complaint modal fields (e.g. complaint-title-input / complaint-description-input / submit-complaint) — currently only new-complaint-fab is easy to target from automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:415 pick_least_loaded_technician — correct aggregation over {assigned,in_progress}; verified live spread across multiple techs.
server.py:459 create_complaint — auto-assign default True (get_setting fallback), auto_assigned flag only set on auto path. Correct.
server.py:481 update_complaint — self-claim only allowed when ticket has no assignee (`not c.get('assigned_to')`); prevents stealing (403). auto_assigned reset to false on manual assign.
server.py:467 list_complaints — team gets `own OR (unassigned AND open)` — this is the core bug fix and is verified by the pytest suite.
server.py:428/437 GET/PATCH /api/settings — proper RBAC via require_role('admin','super_admin'), upsert on write.

Test infra fix applied: /app/backend/tests/test_iter3_auto_assign.py had a pytest-xdist race (TestAutoAssignOff.disable_auto_assign on one worker toggled the shared server flag while TestAutoAssignOn on the other worker was creating a complaint, causing 3 sporadic FAILs). Added an autouse module-level FileLock (/tmp/iter3_auto_assign.lock) to serialize this module across xdist workers — no changes to pytest.ini or addopts (-n 2 --dist loadscope preserved). 17/17 now green under the mandated parallel config.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for previously verified flows (iter3); iter4 smoke only re-confirmed subscriber login + new-complaint modal open + team segments render — deeper UI regression not repeated since app code untouched since iter3

seed_data_creation: auto_assign restored to True by module-scoped autouse teardown. TEST_ prefixed complaints created by pytest are harmless demo data.
